items.title: Wangala Golden Jubilee to feature 1,000 drums
items.summary: The Meghalaya Government announced a special 1,000-drums presentation for the 50th organised celebration of the 100 Drums Wangala Festival, scheduled for 11–14 November 2026 in West Garo Hills. Wangala is a Garo post-harvest thanksgiving festival associated with Misi Saljong.
items.examRelevance: Garo culture, harvest festivals and state heritage.

items.title: Meghalaya notifies Electric Vehicle Policy 2026
items.summary: The policy aims to promote electric mobility, reduce dependence on fossil fuels, improve air quality and encourage investment and employment. It supersedes the 2021 policy and remains in force for three years from Gazette notification.
items.examRelevance: State policy, transport decarbonisation and environmental governance.

items.title: Rupee records its strongest monthly gain since February
items.summary: Reuters reported that the rupee closed at ₹94.95 per US dollar on 30 October and gained about 1% during October. The report described RBI measures to curb dollar demand and support the currency; elevated oil prices remained a risk.
items.examRelevance: RBI, foreign-exchange markets, exchange rates and imported inflation.
items.verificationStatus: dated Reuters report reviewed; market data is date-specific

items.title: Finance Ministry constitutes high-level committee on banking reforms
items.summary: Reuters reported that the Finance Ministry established a high-level committee to review India's banking sector and identify reforms to support economic growth and global competitiveness. The report did not specify the committee's membership, detailed terms of reference or timeline.
items.examRelevance: Department of Financial Services, banking governance and financial reforms.
items.verificationStatus: dated Reuters report reviewed; committee details not yet specified in report

items.title: Green Climate Fund approves US$1.97 billion for 21 projects
items.summary: Reuters reported that the Green Climate Fund approved US$1.97 billion across 21 projects, taking the fund's reported 2026 approvals to US$3.2 billion.
items.examRelevance: Climate finance, multilateral institutions and international climate action.
